description_hook: A syllabus tells you how fast a course will expire, if you read it the right way. Priya read hers one module at a time.
problem_domain: choosing an AI course that will still be true next year
setting: a home desk covered in printed syllabus pages and highlighters

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: 34, shoulder-length black hair tied back, grey zip hoodie, always working from a tabbed spiral notebook

claims.claim: Priya counted 12 modules in the syllabus she had just bought
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption about one course outline, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: Nine were screenshots of one interface
claims.basis: illustrative split of the same example syllabus

claims.claim: Three taught evaluation and failure checks
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated example: 12 modules minus 9 interface modules

scenes.narration: Most AI courses teach the buttons, not the judgement.
scenes.caption: ज्यादातर ऐआई कोर्स बटन सिखाते हैं, समझ नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A tall stack of printed course syllabus pages on a dark desk, page after page filled only with screenshots of software menus and toolbars, one blunt pencil resting on top, soft lamplight from the left side, quiet and skeptical mood.

scenes.narration: Priya bought a course built entirely around one tool's menus.
scenes.caption: प्रिया ने ऐसा कोर्स खरीदा जो सिर्य ऐक टूल के मेन्यू पर बना था।
scenes.image_brief: A printed twelve page syllabus fanned out across a pale wooden desk next to a paper payment receipt, every module heading beginning with the name of a software menu, warm morning light coming through a window behind, orderly and hopeful mood.

scenes.narration: Six weeks later the menus had moved. Her notes were scrap.
scenes.caption: छह हम्ते बाद मेन्यू बदल गऐ। उसके नोट्स बेकार हो गऐ।
scenes.image_brief: An open spiral notebook on a desk, pages of handwritten menu paths and click sequences now struck through in red ink, a crumpled torn page beside it, flat grey daylight, mood of wasted effort.

scenes.narration: Here is how to read any syllabus before you pay for it.
scenes.caption: पैसे देने से पहले किसी भी सिलेबस को परखने का तरीका यह है।
scenes.image_brief: A syllabus page clipped to a board with two hand drawn columns beside the module list, one column headed decision and the other headed click, an uncapped marker lying across the page, bright even desk light, practical mood.

scenes.narration: Menus change fast. The reasoning underneath them barely moves at all.
scenes.caption: मेन्यू तेजी से बदलते हैं। पीछे की सोच लगभग वैसी ही रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two shelves one above the other in a study, the upper shelf crowded with loose menu printouts mid swap and slipping sideways, the lower shelf holding three worn hardbound notebooks sitting perfectly still, dusty warm light falling from above, contrast between churn and permanence.

scenes.narration: So score every module with one question: a decision, or a click?
scenes.caption: तो हर मॉड्यूल को ऐक सवाल से जांचें: फैसला या क्लिक?
scenes.image_brief: A single module line on a syllabus with a large inked question mark drawn beside it and two small hand ruled tick boxes labelled decision and click, the rest of the page left blank, soft light falling straight onto the paper, focused mood.

scenes.narration: Priya counted 12 modules in the syllabus she had just bought.
scenes.caption: प्रिया ने अभी खरीदे सिलेबस में 12 मॉड्यूल गिने।
scenes.image_brief: A syllabus sheet on a desk listing twelve numbered module rows, small pencil tally marks counted down the margin beside them, a mug leaving a damp ring on the paper edge, low evening lamplight, focused mood.

scenes.narration: Nine were screenshots of one interface. Three taught evaluation and failure checks.
scenes.caption: नौ सिर्य इंटरफेस के स्क्रीनशॉट थे। तीन मूल्यांकन सिखाते थे।
scenes.image_brief: The same syllabus torn apart into two paper piles on a desk, a thick pile of pages showing interface screenshots on the left and a thin pile of three pages headed evaluation and failure checks on the right, cool daylight across both, decisive mood.

scenes.narration: This test fails for a one-week onboarding course at work.
scenes.caption: ऐक हम्ते की ऑफिस ट्रेनिंग पर यह जांच काम नहीं करती।
scenes.image_brief: A single page onboarding agenda taped to an office partition wall, a laminated shortcut card pinned beside it, a shared desk below holding one open laptop with a single dashboard filling the screen, bright flat office ceiling light, brisk businesslike mood.

scenes.narration: When a team must ship on one chosen tool tomorrow, clicks are the point.
scenes.caption: जब टीम को कल ही ऐक टूल पर काम करना है, तो क्लिक ही असली बात है।
scenes.image_brief: A busy shared office desk with one dashboard filling a laptop screen, a printed keyboard shortcut sheet propped against the stand, a yellow sticky note on the monitor edge with a single word circled, hard overhead light, urgent mood.

scenes.narration: The judgement modules aged well. The interface modules expired in weeks.
scenes.caption: समझ वाले मॉड्यूल टिके रहे। इंटरफेस वाले हम्तों में खत्म हो गऐ।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper piles left on a windowsill, one thick pile of interface printouts yellowed and curling at the corners, one thin pile of evaluation notes still clean and flat, late afternoon light stretching across both, reflective mood.

scenes.narration: The syllabus told her all of that before the payment did.
scenes.caption: यह सब सिलेबस ने पेमेंट से पहले ही बता दिया था।
scenes.image_brief: A marked up syllabus page and an untouched paper payment receipt lying side by side on a clean desk, the syllabus margins dense with ink annotations, soft window light from one side, mood of a lesson learned.

scenes.narration: Open any syllabus tonight and mark each module: decision or click?
scenes.caption: आज कोई सिलेबस खोलें और हर मॉड्यूल पर लिखें: फैसला या क्लिक?
scenes.image_brief: A freshly printed course syllabus clipped to a board on a tidy desk, a marker pen lying uncapped beside it and two empty hand ruled label columns waiting to be filled, warm desk lamp light, inviting and actionable mood.

title: 🎯 Rohan judged an AI tool by its demo... build this test instead #aitools #evals
title_alts: 🎯 Rohan's 20-task test ranks any AI tool... in one quiet afternoon #aitools #evals
🎯 Rohan almost bought an AI tool on a seller's demo... don't #aitools #evals
description_hook: Every demo was built to pass. Rohan replaced the demo prompts with twenty tasks from his own backlog and the ranking flipped.
problem_domain: comparing AI tools without trusting the vendor's own examples
setting: a cramped support team desk with a wall of printed tickets

characters.name: Rohan
characters.description: 29, close cropped hair, thin wire glasses, faded blue work shirt, keeps a rubber banded stack of printed tickets

claims.claim: Rohan pasted 20 support tickets from his own backlog
claims.basis: round illustrative sample size, stated as an example in the narration
illustrative result on the example sample of 20 tasks

claims.claim: Tool B cleared 11 and invented two policies
claims.basis: illustrative result on the same example sample

scenes.narration: A demo is chosen by the seller, not by you.
scenes.caption: डेमो विक्रेता छांटता है, आप नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A polished product demo page glowing on a monitor in a dim room, three tidy sample prompts listed in a neat card, the surrounding desk bare and dark, cold blue screen light spilling onto the wood, staged and salesy mood.

scenes.narration: Rohan compared three AI writing tools using only their own sample prompts.
scenes.caption: रोहन ने तीन ऐआई टूल सिर्य उनके ही सैंपल प्रॉम्प्ट से परखे।
scenes.image_brief: Three browser windows arranged side by side on one wide monitor, each showing the same kind of flawless sample output with green tick marks, a notepad below the screen with three tool names and identical high scores, even office light, uneasy sameness.

scenes.narration: 20 of your own real tasks settle it in one afternoon.
scenes.caption: आपके अपने 20 असली काम ऐक ही दोपहर में फैसला कर देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed grid of twenty numbered task rows taped to a wall beside a desk, tool names written as column headings in marker, most cells still empty, afternoon sun cutting across the paper, methodical and determined mood.

scenes.narration: Why? A demo's examples were picked because the tool handles them well.
scenes.caption: क्यों? डेमो के उदाहरण वही होते हैं जो टूल आसानी से संभाल लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: A drawer of task cards standing open on a desk, three shiny laminated cards lifted proudly to the front while dozens of dog eared handwritten cards stay pressed at the back, warm lamplight on the front cards and shadow behind, mood of quiet selection bias.

scenes.narration: Your tasks carry your vocabulary, your formats, your awkward edge cases.
scenes.caption: आपके काम में आपकी भाषा, आपके प्रारूप और मुश्किल मामले होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A real support ticket printed on paper and spread on a desk, crowded with internal shorthand, a half filled refund table and a customer message that contradicts itself, sticky flags marking two confusing lines, plain desk light, mood of everyday mess.

scenes.narration: Rohan pasted 20 support tickets from his own backlog.
scenes.caption: रोहन ने अपने बैकलॉग से 20 असली टिकट लगाऐ।
scenes.image_brief: Twenty printed support tickets laid out in four rows on a desk, each one numbered by hand in the corner, a rubber band discarded beside the stack, plain daylight from a nearby window, workmanlike mood.

scenes.narration: Tool A cleared 14. Tool B cleared 11 and invented two policies.
scenes.caption: टूल ऐ ने 14 पास किऐ। टूल बी ने 11, और दो नियम गढ़ लिऐ।
scenes.image_brief: The wall grid now filled in with marker, one column showing fourteen ticks, the next showing eleven ticks with two cells ringed in red and labelled invented rule, the paper slightly curling at the tape, hard afternoon light, revealing mood.

scenes.narration: Twenty tasks will not surface the rare, dangerous failures.
scenes.caption: बीस काम दुर्लभ और खतरनाक गलतियां सामने नहीं लाते।
scenes.image_brief: A wide fishing net stretched over a table catching twenty large paper slips while several tiny dark slips fall straight through the mesh onto the floor below, low side light picking out the fallen slips, cautionary mood.

scenes.narration: For anything safety-critical you need review, not a sample.
scenes.caption: सुरक्षा से जुड़े काम में सैंपल नहीं, पूरी जांच जरूरी है।
scenes.image_brief: A thick bound procedure manual open on a review table with a signature block and two initialled stamps on the page, a small sample printout pushed aside to the table edge, steady white overhead light, serious institutional mood.

scenes.narration: The winner had the weaker demo. It fit his work better.
scenes.caption: जीतने वाले का डेमो कमजोर था। पर वह काम में ज्यादा बैठा।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed scorecards on a desk, the plainer one with a hand drawn circle around its total and the glossier one left face up beside it unmarked, the twenty ticket stack squared neatly on top of the winner, warm evening lamplight, satisfied mood.

scenes.narration: Every tool looks strong until your own messy work arrives.
scenes.caption: हर टूल मजबूत लगता है, जब तक आपका उलझा काम सामने न आऐ।
scenes.image_brief: A clean empty desk on one half of the frame and the same desk on the other half buried under printed tickets, sticky notes and marked up pages, the same monitor standing in both halves, uneven light bright on the clean side and dim on the buried side, honest mood.

scenes.narration: Collect 20 real tasks today. Run the next trial on those.
scenes.caption: आज 20 असली काम इकट्ठा करें। अगला ट्रायल उन्हीं पर करें।
scenes.image_brief: An empty labelled folder standing upright on a desk beside a small pile of twenty printed tasks ready to go in, a pen resting across the folder edge, bright morning light from the window, ready and purposeful mood.

title: 💸 Meera's team called the AI tool free... one number disagreed #aitools #aibudget
title_alts: 💸 Meera's per-task math... what an AI seat really earns you #aitools #aibudget
💸 Meera's idle AI seats quietly cost the most... here is why #aitools #aibudget
description_hook: A seat charges the same whether you use it once or a hundred times. Meera divided the bill by finished tasks and the picture changed.
problem_domain: working out whether a paid AI seat is worth keeping
setting: a small shared office with two desks and a wall planner
protagonist_type: operations manager on a tight budget

characters.name: Meera
characters.description: 41, dark hair in a short bob, rimless glasses, olive green cardigan, carries a worn pocket calculator everywhere

claims.basis: round illustrative range used to show the flat-rate effect, stated as an example

claims.claim: about 8 finished tasks a month per seat
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated example: twice a week across four weeks

claims.claim: pushed each seat to 20 tasks monthly
claims.basis: arithmetic on the stated example: 8 existing tasks plus three weekly reports across four weeks

scenes.narration: A flat AI subscription gets cheaper every single time you use it.
scenes.caption: फ्लैट ऐआई सब्सक्रिप्शन हर इस्तेमाल के साथ सस्ता होता जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single monthly invoice sheet pinned to a corkboard above a desk, beneath it a long column of small handwritten task marks running down past the bottom of the paper, warm lamplight from one side, mood of quiet arithmetic.

scenes.narration: Meera's team paid for two seats and opened them twice a week.
scenes.caption: मीरा की टीम ने दो सीटें लीं, पर खोलीं हब्ते में दो बार।
scenes.image_brief: Two chairs at a long shared table with two closed laptops sitting untouched, a paper week planner on the wall behind marked on only two days of each row, cool morning light through half open blinds, mood of underuse.

scenes.narration: One division shows whether a paid seat earns its keep.
scenes.caption: ऐक भाग बता देता है कि सीट अपनी कीमत वसूल कर रही है या नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A pocket calculator resting on top of a monthly invoice with the division key held down, a torn slip of paper beside it carrying one figure circled twice in pen, tight desk lamp light on the paper, decisive mood.

scenes.narration: Why? A seat costs the same whether it runs 5 tasks or 500.
scenes.caption: क्यों? सीट का दाम वही रहता है, चाहे 5 काम हों या 500।
scenes.image_brief: A small balance scale on a desk holding one flat rate ticket stub on the left pan, five paper task slips on the right pan barely moving it, and a cardboard box beside the scale spilling hundreds of identical slips onto the desk, even overhead light, mood of imbalance.

scenes.narration: So unit cost is simply the bill divided by tasks finished.
scenes.caption: यानी प्रति काम लागत = बिल बंटा पूरे हुऐ काम।
scenes.image_brief: A handwritten ledger page open on a desk with a single bill figure written at the top, a long tally of finished tasks listed underneath, and a ruled pen line drawn between the two, plain daylight from the window, clear analytical mood.

scenes.narration: Twice a week meant about 8 finished tasks a month per seat.
scenes.caption: हब्ते में दो बार यानी प्रति सीट महीने में करीब 8 काम।
scenes.image_brief: A large monthly wall planner carrying only eight small task stickers spread thinly across its grid, wide empty boxes on every other day, a pen dangling from a string beside the planner, pale window light, sparse mood.

scenes.narration: Adding three weekly reports pushed each seat to 20 tasks monthly.
scenes.caption: तीन साप्ताहिक रिपोर्ट जोड़ने पर हर सीट पर 20 काम हो गऐ।
scenes.image_brief: The same monthly wall planner now covered with twenty task stickers, three of them repeating in the same weekday column every week and hand labelled report, the rest scattered through the grid, brighter daylight on the paper, mood of filling up.

scenes.narration: This breaks when the tool bills you per request instead.
scenes.caption: यह गणित टूट जाता है जब टूल हर रिक्वेस्ट का बिल बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A metered counter box mounted on a wall wired to a chute of request slips feeding through it one by one, the number wheels on its dial part way through turning, cold utility room light, wary mood.

scenes.narration: Then volume pushes the bill up, and the discount never arrives.
scenes.caption: तब ज्यादा इस्तेमाल बिल बढ़ाता है, और दाम कम कभी नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: A paper chart taped beside the wall meter with a marker line climbing steeply from left to right, the growing pile of used request slips heaped on the floor below it, the word discount written and crossed out in the corner, harsh fluorescent light, sobering mood.

scenes.narration: Idle seats are the expensive ones. Busy seats quietly pay for themselves.
scenes.caption: खाली पड़ी सीटें ही महंगी हैं। व्यस्त सीटें खुद की कीमत निकाल लेती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two office chairs side by side at one shared desk, the left one under a visible layer of dust with an untouched keyboard in front of it, the right one worn shiny at the armrests with a full tray of finished task sheets beside it, late afternoon light falling across both, pointed contrast.

scenes.narration: Count last month's finished tasks per seat. Divide the bill by that.
scenes.caption: पिछले महीने के काम गिनें। बिल को उसी संख्या से बांटें।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook lying open on a desk with two labelled lines ruled and waiting, one headed tasks finished and one headed monthly bill, a pocket calculator and a pen resting on the facing page, bright morning light from the left, ready mood.

title: 🎓 Arjun's AI certificate convinced nobody... so what actually does? #aicourses #portfolio
title_alts: 🎓 Arjun's one-page project log beats his AI certificate... here's how #aicourses #portfolio
🎓 Arjun spent the AI course hours proving attendance... not judgement #aicourses #portfolio
description_hook: Arjun finished the course and framed the proof nobody asked for. The same hours could have produced something a reviewer would open.
problem_domain: turning AI course hours into evidence someone will actually read
setting: a bedroom desk with a printer and a pinboard of project pages

characters.name: Arjun
characters.description: 26, curly hair, thin moustache, maroon t-shirt, ink stain on his right thumb from constant note taking

claims.claim: 12 applications later, not one reviewer had mentioned it
claims.basis: round illustrative count of one person's applications, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: Arjun rebuilt three course assignments using his own messy work data
claims.basis: illustrative number of rebuilt assignments in the same example

scenes.narration: Nobody checks the certificate. Everybody opens the link.
scenes.caption: सर्टिफिकेट कोई नहीं जांचता। लिंक सब खोलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A framed printed certificate hanging slightly crooked on a bare wall while the desk below holds an open laptop showing a single project page, the cursor arrow resting on its link, lamplight favouring the laptop and leaving the frame dim, mood of misplaced pride.

scenes.narration: Arjun finished a long AI course and printed the certificate proudly.
scenes.caption: अर्जुन ने लंबा ऐआई कोर्स पूरा किया और गर्व से सर्टिफिकेट छपवाया।
scenes.image_brief: A freshly printed certificate lying flat on a desk beside a thick finished course workbook, the certificate corners still curling from the printer and a printer sitting warm behind it, warm overhead light, proud and hopeful mood.

scenes.narration: 12 applications later, not one reviewer had mentioned it.
scenes.caption: 12 आवेदन के बाद भी किसी समीक्षक ने उसका जिक्र नहीं किया।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of twelve printed job application copies squared on a desk, each with a photocopy of the same certificate stapled behind it, every certificate page clean and unmarked while the pages in front carry reviewer notes, flat grey daylight, mood of silence.

scenes.narration: There is a better output from exactly the same course hours.
scenes.caption: उन्हीं कोर्स के घंटों से कुछ बेहतर बन सकता था।
scenes.image_brief: The same course workbook lying open on a desk next to a blank sheet headed with an empty space for a project write up, a pen laid diagonally across the blank sheet, soft directional desk light, mood of a better idea forming.

scenes.narration: A certificate proves attendance. It cannot prove judgement at all.
scenes.caption: सर्टिफिकेट हाजिरी साबित करता है। समझ वह साबित नहीं कर सकता।
scenes.image_brief: An attendance register open on a table filled with neat rows of ticks and signatures, a closed decision log lying beside it with a blank cover and no entries showing, even institutional light from above, mood of thin evidence.

scenes.narration: A working artifact shows the decisions you made, and the ones you rejected.
scenes.caption: बना हुआ काम दिखाता है क्या चुना और क्या छोड़ा।
scenes.image_brief: A single project page pinned to a board showing a written problem statement, a prompt block below it and a crossed out approach with a short handwritten note beside the crossing, a crumpled discarded draft on the floor under the board, clear desk light, mood of visible thinking.

scenes.narration: Arjun rebuilt three course assignments using his own messy work data.
scenes.caption: अर्जुन ने तीन असाइनमेंट अपने उलझे दफ्तरी डेटा से दोबारा बनाऐ।
scenes.image_brief: Three printed course assignments spread across a desk, each overwritten in pen with real awkward figures and unfamiliar column names copied from a workplace spreadsheet, the clean original versions pushed to the desk edge, warm afternoon light, industrious mood.

scenes.narration: Each became a short page: the problem, the prompt, the failure he fixed.
scenes.caption: हर ऐक ऐक पन्ना बना: समस्या, प्रॉम्प्ट और सुधारी गई गलती।
scenes.image_brief: Three short project pages pinned in a row on a board, each divided into three labelled sections for the problem, the prompt and the failure that was fixed, a red thread linking the three failure sections, soft even light, orderly mood.

scenes.narration: Some employers screen on credentials before a human ever looks.
scenes.caption: कुल कंपनियां इंसान से पहले ही डिग्री से छांटी कर लेती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: An applicant tracking screen in a dim room listing many candidate rows with a credential filter switch turned on, most rows greyed out and marked unread, cold blue monitor light across the empty desk, impersonal mood.

scenes.narration: In regulated hiring, the certificate is simply the ticket in.
scenes.caption: नियमों से बंधी भर्ती में सर्टिफिकेट ही दाखिले का टिकट है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed hiring checklist in a formal office with a required certificate line ticked in ink and a certificate photocopy clipped behind it, a rubber stamp and ink pad set beside the open folder, plain overhead light, procedural mood.

scenes.narration: The course hours were identical. Only the evidence changed.
scenes.caption: कोर्स के घंटे वही थे। सिर्य सबूत बदल गया।
scenes.image_brief: An hourglass standing on a desk between the framed certificate on one side and the three pinned project pages on the other, equal sand visible in both of its chambers, even light spread across the whole desk, reflective mood.

scenes.narration: Interviews started asking about his failures, not about the syllabus.
scenes.caption: इंटरव्यू में सिलेबस नहीं, उसकी गलतियों की बात हुई।
scenes.image_brief: An interview table with one project page turned toward an empty guest chair, its failure section circled in pen and two follow up questions written in the margin, the course syllabus lying unopened at the far table edge, warm room light, engaged mood.

scenes.narration: Pick one assignment. Redo it on your own data this week.
scenes.caption: ऐक असाइनमेंट छांटें। इस हब्ते उसे अपने डेटा पर दोहराऐं।
scenes.image_brief: One course assignment sheet lying on a desk beside a laptop showing a spreadsheet of raw unsorted work data, a pen and a blank project page set ready next to them, bright morning light from a window, actionable mood.

title: 🪜 Sameer's one giant prompt vs prompt chaining... which rework wins? #promptchaining #aitools
title_alts: 🪜 Sameer's prompt chain gives every error an address... here's how #promptchaining #aitools
🪜 Sameer kept rewriting 300 words to fix 40... stop doing that #promptchaining #aitools
description_hook: One prompt returns one verdict: it worked, or it did not. Sameer cut his into three steps and the broken step named itself.
problem_domain: debugging a long AI prompt that fails for no clear reason
setting: a workbench of paper trays, cut prompt cards and labels
protagonist_type: analyst who writes his own prompts

characters.name: Sameer

scenes.narration: One giant prompt hides the exact step that actually failed.
scenes.caption: ऐक लंबा प्रॉम्प्ट वह कदम छिपा लेता है जो वाकई बिगड़ा।
scenes.image_brief: A single long printed prompt taped into one continuous paper strip running down a wall beside a desk, one line somewhere in the middle marked with a faint pencil dot that is easy to miss, dim lamplight from the side, mood of a hidden fault.

scenes.narration: Sameer wrote a 300-word prompt to draft, edit and format a report.
scenes.caption: समीर ने 300 शब्दों का प्रॉम्प्ट लिखा: ड्राफ्ट, संपादन और फॉर्मेट।
scenes.image_brief: A dense block of prompt text printed on one sheet lying on a desk, three different instruction jobs crammed into the same paragraph and separated only by commas, an unused highlighter resting beside the page, warm desk light, cluttered mood.

scenes.narration: Splitting it into steps tells you exactly which part needs the fix.
scenes.caption: प्रॉम्प्ट को चरणों में बांटें, तो पता चलेगा किस हिस्से को सुधारना है।
scenes.image_brief: The same prompt sheet cut into three paper cards laid in a neat row on a desk, a pair of scissors resting beside them and a clear gap left between each card, clean daylight across the desk, mood of clarity arriving.

scenes.narration: Where do you even start? A single prompt returns one output and one verdict.
scenes.caption: शुरू कहां से करें? ऐक प्रॉम्प्ट ऐक नतीजा और ऐक फैसला देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A sealed grey box standing on a workbench with one input slot and one output slot, a single finished page lying in the output tray stamped with one large cross, nothing else visible on the bench, flat overhead light, mood of a black box.

scenes.narration: Chained steps return an output per step, so every error has an address.
scenes.caption: चरणों में हर कदम का नतीजा मिलता है, तो हर गलती का पता मिलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A row of three small paper trays on a workbench, each holding the printed output of one step and each labelled with a number, a single red flag standing upright in the first tray only, bright even light, diagnostic mood.

scenes.narration: Sameer split his prompt into three: outline, then draft, then format.
scenes.caption: समीर ने प्रॉम्प्ट तीन में बांटा: रूपरेखा, ड्राफ्ट, फॉर्मेट।
scenes.image_brief: Three labelled paper cards pinned in a line on a board reading outline, draft and format, short arrows drawn between them in marker, the original single dense sheet folded away on the desk below, plain desk light, orderly mood.

scenes.narration: The outline step was wrong every single time. The other two were fine.
scenes.caption: रूपरेखा वाला कदम हर बार गलत था। बाकी दो ठीक थे।
scenes.image_brief: The first tray on the workbench holding four printed attempts with every one circled in red, while the two trays beside it hold clean unmarked pages, hard light falling on the red circles, revealing mood.

scenes.narration: Chains cost more calls, more waiting, and more plumbing to maintain.
scenes.caption: चरणों का मतलब ज्यादा कॉल, ज्यादा इंतजार और ज्यादा रखरखाव।
scenes.image_brief: Three meters lined up on a workshop shelf, each wired with its own thick cable and each dial reading higher than the lone meter standing beside them, a tangle of spare cabling coiled on the floor below, cool workshop light, mood of added cost.

scenes.narration: For a single one-off email, one prompt is honestly still faster.
scenes.caption: ऐक बार के ईमेल के लिऐ ऐक ही प्रॉम्प्ट सचमुच तेज है।
scenes.image_brief: One short email printed on a single slip of paper on a bare desk with no trays, cables or labels anywhere near it, a stopwatch beside the slip stopped at a very small time, bright simple daylight, brisk mood.

scenes.narration: He rewrote 40 words of instructions instead of rewriting all 300.
scenes.caption: उसने 300 नहीं, सिर्य 40 शब्द दोबारा लिखे।
scenes.image_brief: A page of prompt instructions on a desk with one short paragraph rewritten in fresh dark ink and every other line left completely untouched, an eraser sitting on the edited paragraph, focused lamplight, efficient mood.

scenes.narration: The failure finally had an address, so the fix stayed very small.
scenes.caption: गलती का पता मिल गया, तो सुधार बहुत छोटा रहा।
scenes.image_brief: A small handwritten address label stuck to the front of the first tray in the row of three, the label filled in with a step name, the other two trays standing clean and closed beside it, warm side light, satisfied mood.

scenes.narration: Take your longest prompt. Cut it at the first handoff.
scenes.caption: अपना सबसे लंबा प्रॉम्प्ट लें। पहले मोड़ पर उसे काट दें।
scenes.image_brief: A long printed prompt lying flat on a cutting mat with scissors positioned at the first natural break in the text and a pencil mark showing where the cut goes, bright task light overhead, actionable mood.

title: ⏳ Kavya's AI draft saved an hour... then verification sent the bill #aitools #factchecking
title_alts: ⏳ Kavya's net-time test shows if an AI tool truly helps... try it #aitools #factchecking
⏳ Kavya counted drafting minutes... and forgot the checking ones #aitools #factchecking
description_hook: The drafting got faster and the checking got longer. Kavya timed both halves before deciding the tool had saved her anything.
problem_domain: measuring whether an AI summary actually saves time once it is checked
setting: a library reading table stacked with source volumes and stopwatches
protagonist_type: research assistant who cites her sources

characters.name: Kavya
characters.description: 31, long braided hair, tortoiseshell reading glasses, mustard scarf, keeps a stopwatch on a lanyard

claims.claim: Drafting a summary took Kavya 10 minutes instead of 40
claims.basis: round illustrative timings for one summary, stated as an example in the narration
round illustrative verification time for the same example summary
arithmetic on the stated example: 10 minutes drafting plus 35 minutes checking against 40 minutes by hand

scenes.narration: Time saved drafting can be lost checking.
scenes.caption: ड्राफ्ट में बचा समय जांच में चला जा सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two stopwatches standing side by side on a reading table, the left one showing a small elapsed time and the right one showing a much larger elapsed time, a typed summary page lying between them, cool morning light from a tall window, mood of a hidden trade.

scenes.narration: Kavya used an AI tool to summarise dense research documents.
scenes.caption: काव्या ने भारी शोध दस्तावेजों का सार ऐआई टूल से बनवाया।
scenes.image_brief: A tall pile of dense research documents on a reading table with one thin typed summary page resting on top of the pile, tiny dense print visible on the stacked pages beneath, warm lamplight from behind the pile, mood of compression.

scenes.narration: The summaries read beautifully. Two citations pointed at nothing.
scenes.caption: सारांश बहुत अच्था लगा। पर दो संदर्भ खाली थे।
scenes.image_brief: A neatly typed summary page on a table with two reference lines at the bottom, a drawn pen arrow leading from each of those lines to an empty slot on a nearby shelf where no source volume stands, flat grey daylight, unsettling mood.

scenes.narration: One subtraction tells you whether the tool is helping.
scenes.caption: ऐक घटाव बता देता है कि टूल सचमुच मदद कर रहा है या नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A simple handwritten subtraction on a notepad on a table, one line headed minutes saved and one line headed minutes spent checking with a ruled line drawn beneath both, a focused desk lamp lighting just the notepad, clear mood.

scenes.narration: Generation is fast because it does not stop to verify.
scenes.caption: लिखना तेज है क्योंकि वह जांचने के लिऐ रुकता नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page sliding quickly off a printer into an empty tray, not a single source document open anywhere on the surrounding table, bright even light across the bare surface, mood of effortless speed.

scenes.narration: Verification is slow because every claim has to be traced back.
scenes.caption: जांच धीमी है क्योंकि हर दावे को स्रोत तक चलना पड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single claim sentence printed on a paper slip on a library table with a pen line traced from it through three open source volumes, sticky flags marking the exact pages, dim reading lamp light over the books, laborious mood.

scenes.narration: Drafting a summary took Kavya 10 minutes instead of 40.
scenes.caption: काव्या को सार लिखने में 40 की जगह 10 मिनट लगे।
scenes.image_brief: One stopwatch stopped at a short elapsed time beside a finished summary page, a thick stack of printed sources standing unopened behind it, late morning light through a window, brisk mood.

scenes.narration: Tracing 18 claims took 35 minutes. Net loss: five minutes.
scenes.caption: 18 दावे जांचने में 35 मिनट लगे। कुल नुकसान: पांच मिनट।
scenes.image_brief: A checking worksheet on a library table listing eighteen numbered claim rows with ticks against most and two rows ringed in red, a second stopwatch beside it showing a long elapsed time, harsh overhead light, sobering mood.

scenes.narration: Where errors are cheap, skip the tracing entirely.
scenes.caption: जहां गलती सस्ती है, वहां जांच को पूरी तरह छोड़ दें।
scenes.image_brief: A scribbled internal note page sitting in a recycling tray beside a desk with no reference marks on it at all, a pen tossed in on top of it, plain office light, relaxed mood.

scenes.narration: A first draft of internal notes needs no citation audit.
scenes.caption: दफ्तरी नोट्स के पहले ड्राफ्ट में संदर्भ जांच की जरूरत नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A rough first draft of meeting notes spread on a desk with half finished bullet points, the printed citation checklist lying face down and unused beside it, soft afternoon light, unbothered mood.

scenes.narration: Speed only counts after verification. Measure the pair, not the draft.
scenes.caption: रफ्तार जांच के बाद ही मायने रखती है। दोनों को नापें।
scenes.image_brief: A small balance scale on a reading table with the typed summary page on one pan and the checking worksheet on the other, the two pans resting almost level, a stopwatch standing at each end of the table, even light, reflective mood.

scenes.narration: Kavya kept the tool for outlines and wrote citations by hand.
scenes.caption: काव्या ने रूपरेखा टूल से ली, संदर्भ खुद हाथ से लिखे।
scenes.image_brief: A printed outline page on a library table with handwritten citations added in ink under each section, the source volumes open beside it flagged at the exact pages cited, warm lamplight over the table, mood of a working compromise.

scenes.narration: Time your next verification pass. Subtract it from what you saved.
scenes.caption: अगली जांच का समय नापें। बचे समय से उसे घटा दें।
scenes.image_brief: A blank timing sheet clipped to a board on a table with two empty rows labelled drafting and checking, a stopwatch resting on the clip and a pen lying beside it, bright morning light, ready mood.
